messages:
Priya Nair: Quick org update — effective Mon Apr 6 we're splitting Eng Platform into two subteams: Runtime (latency/caching/serving) and Infra (capacity/orchestration). Mateo Reyes will be interim Runtime lead for ~6 weeks while we run a backfill process for the SRE seat. Details below.

Mateo Reyes: Happy to jump in and help with the handoff. I'll run a 30m sync next Tue for EMs/PMs to align priorities. DM me if you have urgent items.

Sophie Li: Congrats Mateo! Quick Q — who owns autoscaling policy until the rotation settles?

Anika Patel: I'll cover autoscaling ops and runbook updates for the interim. Will coordinate with Mateo on any config changes.

Priya Nair: Hiring note: we opened an internal-backfill req (SRE IC3). Recruiting + hiring panel = Priya Nair, Anika Patel, Sophie Li, Liz Gomez. Posting: https://jobs.redwood.com/req/7891 (internal candidate flag set). Internal referrals encouraged — referral bonus applies.

Liz Gomez: Req is live, interview loop drafted (screen -> tech -> onsite subset). I'll post the candidate tracker spreadsheet and calendar templates in #recruiting in a bit.

Mateo Reyes: I'll take on oncall week coverage for any gaps during the transition. @oncall-bot please reassign Week B from Sophie -> Mateo.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Shift reassigned: Sophie Li -> Mateo Reyes (Week B) — ack.

Priya Nair: Quick operational asks: 1) Keep rolling deploy windows the same unless there's a risk to latency, 2) Avoid large infra churn first week, 3) PMs please surface top 2 runtime priorities to Mateo by Fri EOD.

Sophie Li: Noted. We'll freeze non-essential infra changes the first week and send a short runbook excerpt to Mateo.

Anika Patel: I'll lock any non-critical deploys for the first 3 business days and update the status page. Also will add handoff checklist to the runbook.

Mateo Reyes: Thanks — I'll post 3 top goals by EOD Fri and set up 1:1s with the team next week.

Priya Nair: Welcome plan: we'll do an intro thread + 30m 'ask me anything' next Wed for Mateo. Recruiting will prioritize internal applicants for the SRE role; external search begins in 2 weeks if no suitable internal match.

Sophie Li: Congrats again, Mateo — can we add a small note to docs about who owns which dashboard during this time?

Anika Patel: On it. I'll add an ownership table to the runbook with contact handles.

Liz Gomez: FYI hiring panel will try to schedule interviews during TZ-friendly windows; internal candidates get priority timeslots.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — ping me or Liz if you want to be on the hiring loop or refer someone. :partyparrot:

Sophie Li: +1, sending a referral DM now.

Mateo Reyes: Appreciate the support.

Anika Patel: :thumbsup:
